title: Little progress reverse-engineering recovered craft: caveman with a USB drive

tellings.quote: I don't think we've done much with what we've recovered. I think it's like uh you know, um caveman with a USB drive.

plain: Michels believes that the craft the US is said to have recovered, a story going back to 1947, have yielded very little to reverse engineering, meaning taking a device apart to learn how it works and copy it. In his words it is like "caveman with a USB drive": people holding something far beyond them with no idea how to use it. He offers this as his own view, without naming a source.
